title: Gethsemane
lyrics_original: Jesus climbed the hill to the garden still.
His steps were heavy and slow.
Love and a prayer took Him there
To the place only He could go.
Gethsemane. Jesus loves me,
So He went willingly to Gethsemane.
He felt all that was sad, wicked, or bad,
All the pain we would ever know.
While His friends were asleep, He fought to keep
His promise made long ago.
Gethsemane. Jesus loves me,
So He went willingly to Gethsemane.
The hardest thing that ever was done,
The greatest pain that ever was known,
The biggest battle that ever was won—
This was done by Jesus!
The fight was won by Jesus!
Gethsemane. Jesus loves me,
So He gave His gift to me in Gethsemane.
Gethsemane. Jesus loves me,
So He gives His gift to me from Gethsemane.

bible_verses.telugu: అప్పుడు పర లోకమునుండి యొకదూత ఆయనకు కనబడి ఆయనను బలపరచెను.
bible_verses.english: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.

bible_verses.telugu: నిశ్చయముగా అతడు మన రోగములను భరించెను మన వ్యసనములను వహించెను అయినను మొత్తబడినవానిగాను దేవునివలన బాధింపబడినవానిగాను శ్రమనొందినవానిగాను మనమతనిని ఎంచితివిు.
bible_verses.english: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted.

bible_verses.telugu: కొంత   దూరము వెళ్లి, సాగిలపడి  నా తండ్రీ, సాధ్యమైతే ఈ గిన్నె నాయొద్దనుండి తొలగి పోనిమ్ము, అయినను నా యిష్టప్రకారము కాదు నీ చిత్తప్రకారమే కానిమ్మని ప్రార్థించెను.
bible_verses.english: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, 'My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.'

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for going to Gethsemane for me and bearing the pain I could never carry. When I feel overwhelmed or alone, remind me of the quiet strength and relentless love You showed in that garden. Help me to trust Your heart and surrender my own will to Yours every day. Thank You for loving me so deeply and keeping Your promises forever. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In the quiet shadows of Gethsemane, Jesus bore the overwhelming weight of our sorrow and sin, driven entirely by His deep love for us. Even when He felt alone and sorrowful, He chose obedience and willingly walked the path toward the cross to fulfill His promise. As we reflect on His sacrifice, we are invited to rest in the assurance of a love that never falters. May our hearts respond with quiet gratitude, knowing that He carried what we never could.
